d: Is Yash and Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana better than Prabhas' Adipurush? We have 5 reasons why Ramayana seems to have an edge over Adipurush! From stunning VFX and grand visuals to casting, performances, music and cinematic presentation, we (Abhishek Manchanda, Prashant Kapoor) compare the two mythological films and discuss what makes Ramayana stand out. Has the new Ramayana managed to address the shortcomings that audiences pointed out in Adipurush? In this episode of Samosa Critics, we break down 5 key reasons behind the comparison and discuss why expectations from Ramayana are so high. Do…
